_: Art cut from assets/refs/NN.png at measured pt boxes, 2.24173 capture px per design pt. gen.py writes assets/art/.png and places each at its own box, so an asset can never drift from where it was measured. Chrome (chips, cards, buttons, type, tab bar, both modals) is CSS.
_home: 01 and 04 are the same scroll position with a different chip row: max |delta| below y=115 is 26 levels, mean 0.98, so one crop set cut from 04 serves both. The station and mix cards are album artwork; the two track thumbs are album artwork under the bottom fade, so they carry the fade with them and are placed above the fade overlay.
_02: The Jam modal's own illustration, plus the dimmed home screen behind it in four pieces that surround the modal rect exactly (29.5,182.5)-(363.5,668.8). At a black scrim of alpha .802 the backdrop's true colours cannot be recovered: one byte of capture becomes five bytes of source, so a rebuild would invent precision the capture does not hold. The modal itself -- the subject of the screen -- is entirely CSS.
_05: The Codes modal's album collage, plus the dimmed Search screen behind it in four pieces surrounding the modal rect (46.2,233.5)-(346.8,613.7). The backdrop is the Search screen at opacity .115 over #111111, where one byte of capture is 8.7 bytes of source.
